_comment: GET /3/watch/providers/tv?language=en-US, trimmed the same way as
tmdb-providers-movie.json and with the same provenance.
It overlaps that file on Netflix (8) and Amazon Prime Video (9), which is
the normal case: a provider that carries both films and series is in both
directories under one id. The two responses are merged by provider_id
before anything is written, so one provider is one row however many
directories name it. Freevee (613) is here to be a provider only the TV
Netflix's display_priorities differ from the movie file's on purpose: the
merge is last-one-wins per id and the test pins which of the two survives.
